review:
Two Jokers from different universes fight for power on a tiny 3x3, five-line retro comic grid, made with Golden Goat Gaming. Fruit, bars, bells and sevens, with two wild types.

Three scatters give five free spins with VS symbols, where the duelling Jokers can hand out multipliers up to 100x. Big potential on a very small grid. Very high volatility, 7,500x max and 95.5% RTP. Free spins about once every 177 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
